title: Unit Event — Start Rolling! Stars' Crossing — Episode6 Pure and Unfiltered

meta.Event Outline: The Lumina Grand Prix has come at last. The preliminary stage will take place in a specially-built glamorous accommodation facility! A nervous Minori throws herself into life on camera alongside a colorful array of rivals, but she soon meets hurdles.

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's start deciding who's going to represent us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The goal is to put on an “Appealing Talk Show”, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but just trying to appeal to everyone by talking about ourselves probably won't be good enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that they're gonna want you to work with the other idols and make it an exciting show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By working with them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hmm... I made things really awkward yesterday, so I probably shouldn't volunteer...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If that's the case, then I feel that you should go, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only are you very good at making these kinds of appeals, you're also the most talented out of all of us at keeping these sorts of group conversations lively.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I agree...!
I know you'll make things fun for everyone, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You did a great job leaving an impression yesterday, and you even saved me in an entertaining way when I slipped up...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this is sorta my forte...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But is it really okay for us to decide just based on that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I was actually just thinking the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Then, who's gonna represent us...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think you should, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Why?!
I did so awful yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want everyone to get an unfiltered look at what MORE MORE JUMP! is really about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An unfiltered look...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, Airi would likely do a good job of making a solid case for us while keeping that conversation going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But MORE MORE JUMP! still has low name recognition around the country.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And people still associate Airi, Shizuku and me with our old groups, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Those who don't know about our group are probably going to be heavily influenced by what we were like back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, people tend to associate me with variety shows, so our group might be labeled as one that made its name on them...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True... I'm also still strongly associated with Cheerful * Days since I've appeared alongside Arisa and the others quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why I believe we should go with someone that doesn't invite those preconceptions. And more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Someone who will allow them to experience what MORE MORE JUMP! is really about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That someone is me...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I agree.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
The rest is up to how you feel about this, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can you do this for us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Me representing all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In other words, what I say is going to determine what everyone thinks of MORE MORE JUMP!...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I slip up again, it won't just reflect on me. People might think the others are nothing special either...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which is really scary, but...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll do it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you all believe that I can do this, then I want to rise to the occasion!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I want everyone to learn about MORE MORE JUMP! since I love our group so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I promise to do my absolute best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We'll be counting on you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like I said yesterday, it's okay to just be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Go out there, do your best and show them who you are, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...!
se_event_crossing_2025_001

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
<It's almost time!
We ask all participating groups to please gather in the ballroom!>
se_event_crossing_2025_002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Break a leg, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Go blast them with your power!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm really nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I just need to believe what they all said, and believe in myself.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here goes!
A few minutes later
The Lumina Forum - Ballroom

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: We ask the representative of each group to sit at the table in the middle. All others can have a seat in the chairs along the wall.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Understood.
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Tsubaki and Arisa are representing their groups. Who else is...?)

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Oh, Minorin, you're gonna be in the show with us?!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Hehe. That makes me so happy♪
Let's go bang-boom-zippity-zoom and have a real cosmic collision☆

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I knew Hikarin would be here!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, let's throw everything we have at each other!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Twenty-one, twenty-two... Twenty-four! Okay, you're all in your seats! Now, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: It's Lumina Time! These are the events that are going to direct the course of the prelim stage, and here's our first installment! Our “Appealing Talk Show” starts now!

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Let me begin by introducing our special guest and MC for this segment! Here he is!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Hey, it's me, Ueno.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What...?!
Mr. Ueno?! From Hot Dog Man?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What?! No way!!!>
<He's one of the biggest names in comedy.>
<Fame has entered the room!>

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at all the comments.
I actually feel kind of bad for being an old man walking into a room full of idols.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Also, I may technically be the MC, but I'll really just be announcing the topics that are given to me. Still, I promise to keep things fun since I'm getting paid to do this and all.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's really encouraging!
It's great to see you here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm also glad you're here...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Talk about a huge surprise...
They got someone that I see on TV basically every day.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But that also makes sense...
They probably want to get everyone excited thinking about what other celebrities they have lined up.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The producers of this grand prix put a ton of thought into this and are pulling out all the stops.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means I also have to try my best...!!)

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's jump in with our first talking point.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
“Introduce yourself and your group to us!”
Oh, that's remarkably ordinary! The producers for this show must be nice people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness! That means...!)

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Alright, who wants to go first?
Let's get the ball rolling!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, me! I'd like to go first!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Oh, Minorin, that was fast! You're like a first-magnitude star☆

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: That's a unique way to put it!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
But let's set that aside for now...
Umm... Can you tell us who you are and what group you're from?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!
I have a talent for copying idols' dance routines!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've actually learned the dances of a bunch of my fellow idols here, so I'm really excited about getting to be part of the same program!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're making me blush☆
I didn't know you learned some of my dances♪

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Wait, didn't you two meet during orientation?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like Minori's able to speak the way she normally does...

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: So, can you tell us what MORE MORE JUMP! is all about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course!
The best way to put it is...! They're my favorite group!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
You're a fan?!
But you're a member, aren't you?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. I was originally a fan of idols...
And our other members are just so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Starting with Haruka because she's the perfect idol! Not only is she an incredible singer and dancer, she's thinking about her fans 24/7/365! She's the idol of idols, and has thousands upon thousands of fans!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She always makes sure to give everyone the most beautiful smile, and she never forgets to look her fans in the eye and tell them just how much she appreciates them during meet-and-greets! Her aura's so bright that it's hard to keep your eyes open, and...

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Whoa! Too long! Too long!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: We still have to go, remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm so sorry!
Uhh... To summarize...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! consists of Haruka, the perfect idol, Airi, the triple threat of singing, dancing and comedy, Shizuku, beauty incarnate and everyone's source of comfort, and me, Minori Hanasato, the girl who will persevere forever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The four of us have set out to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She came up with more weird taglines for us...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You can tell that she's trying her very best to make a case for us.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
MORE MORE JUMP! really is amazing.
We got to perform together at Idol Lovers, and they're so good at getting a crowd going because they know how to get really close with them!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it's great how close they get with us!>
<Idol Lovers was so awesome.>
<That was an incredible show!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tsubaki...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but everyone in ReLight's also really great! I mean, they're such amazing singers and dancers!! When I saw them on stage during our joint performance, I felt that I had to keep trying harder!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: All this praise is making me blush.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Oh, are you in ReLight?
Then, why don't you go for us next?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Yes, thank you for the segue!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That was good...
They moved things along by playing catch with each other.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, now that Tsubaki's jumped in, things are moving along very smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: Our group is all about...

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Alright, our next topic is “My best moment as an idol!” Who'd like to start us off?

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd like to go!
We have the most fun during our meet and greets!

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: This story's about the first one we did after debuting.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Our next topic is “Only I do this for my fans!”
I'm expecting some good responses for this one.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
In that case, I'd like to go.
My fans request this of me fairly often...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Believe it or not, they'll ask me to scold them.

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line: Oh, this one feels like a big catch!

rows.Speaker: Ueno
rows.Line:
Alright, our next one is “My most appealing features!”
Any volunteers?

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Yes! One of my key features is being able to shine really brightly!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Here, watch me razzle-dazzle☆

rows.Speaker: Other Idols
rows.Line: Wait, is that a light-up outfit?!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Literal shine.>
<She wasn't kidding lol.>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep things going. Next.

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: Wait, you're going faster than a shooting star! You gotta watch me shine more since I made this myself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haha!
Oh, is this thing on top of your head a planet?!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line:
Yeah! I'm glad you noticed, Minorin♪
This is Planet Twinkle♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it's your home! It's cute that you have it on top of your head! So, if I were you, then I'd have Japan on top of mine!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Hehe. That's silly.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: You can't help but giggle when you think about it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I could watch them talk forever.>
<I love how a lot of them are talking like this for the first time!>
<Getting to know more about them is so much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
Everyone seems to be enjoying our talk show!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've gotta keep this momentum going until the very end...!)
